column5: translator for a program whose target is GL_FRAGMENT_PROGRAM_ARB (0x8804) or GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER (0x8b30): appends an IL token stream to a growable buffer at translator+0x28 starting with the IL header words 1, 0x10200 (the same header FUN_000b3630 pushes), error codes 1 (out of memory), 2 (no program), 3 (bad target) in translator[9]

column6: [0] program object, [5] flags, [9] error code, +0x28 IL output buffer {data, count, capacity}

column5: walks the program instruction words (count at program+0x50, offset +0x54, opcode = word >> 18 & 0xff indexing the 0x10-byte opcode info table at 0x1dac34) and emits IL for each; shares its translator state layout with FUN_00048da0

column6: same translator state as FUN_00048da0: [0] program object

column5: two-pass rewrite of an IL token stream: pass one sizes the output (extra words for texture-dependent expansions), pass two copies tokens and expands texld according to the bound texture: depth textures (base format GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT 0x1902) get the GL_DEPTH_TEXTURE_MODE swizzle (GL_ALPHA 0x1906 / GL_LUMINANCE 0x1909 / GL_INTENSITY) and, with compare mode on, the shadow compare sequence

column6: indexes the per-unit texture objects at ctx+0x13f8 and reads ctx+0x276c; ctx+4 -> renderer record
compile record of FUN_000b4400: [3] output token buffer, [0x2b]/[0x45] sampler info, byte +0x46 flag

= *param_4: start of the input IL tokens
position in the input token stream, advanced past each decoded instruction

bit n set when texture unit n holds a GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT (0x1902) texture

output words added by token expansions (+110 for the end token, per the earlier analysis in the function comments)
0x1b extra words for each shadow-compare texld and 4 for the depth-texture-mode fixup
